When I regress either one on the other plus PKC, the coefficient on the other is small, so the link is mostly explained by PKC. That matches the known signalling network for this dataset, in which PKC acts on both P38 and pjnk and there is no direct edge between them.

This is a judgment from the regressions and the known network, not a formal causal-discovery test.
